authority_law: the P-13 single-vintage archive REMAINS THE AUTHORITY regardless of outcome; divergence is recorded honestly and NEVER silently merged or patched; unreachable vendor => sub-step NOT_RUN, honestly recorded
boundedness: exactly 5 requests (one per leg), no chunking, no other endpoints, no other symbols; XAUUSD excluded
comparison_rule: field-by-field exact STRING equality of datetime/open/high/low/close for every date in the intersection of the two samples; per-leg verdict IDENTITY | DIVERGENCE | NO_OVERLAP | VENDOR_UNREACHABLE
entitlement_basis: owner Twelve Data entitlement, V8/V9/NG5/NG6/NG7 precedent (F2)
key_handling: TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY read from the environment file by name only; value never echoed, logged or committed
purpose: F1(iii) bounded TD re-pull cross-check under a fail-closed contract frozen BEFORE the pull (plan §4 F1)
sample_rule: archive sample = the 60 most recent dates per leg in the pinned staging file; fresh sample = one TD time_series 1day request per leg, outputsize=60, as served at pull time
